name: lg_tyranno_tele301
doc: Stands in for saves/tyranno_re/tele301_req.*: Jackie's ch17 (world 1F3, storyline 93) brought to scene 301 (loc 12D, the Tyranno Lair's top) through the ROM's own loader, `ct.exe --teleport 301 8 30 0 --method req`, 300 frames -- as the capture was made; byte for byte the same file.
